focus: Penske and Budget truck-rental desks inside the city of Dallas (East, West, Northwest, South, and Far North Dallas), plus two labor-only crews with Dallas offices
intro: This first Dallas page covers official Penske and Budget truck-rental locations whose own location pages list a Dallas address — including four Home Depot desks open until 7:30 PM every day — plus two labor-only movers whose own sites publish a Dallas address and hours. It is not a complete citywide inventory, and it does not report live truck counts; U-Haul, Fort Worth, and the suburbs are not covered yet. One-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page mentions those services. If you already have a truck or container, use the labor-only filter or the HireAHelper box further down the page.

listings.offersNotes: The official page includes a “Reserve a Truck” path and a “Looking for a one-way rental?” prompt with a phone line. Truck sizes on the lot are not listed as a fixed inventory here, and cargo vans are not mentioned.

listings.name: Evolution Moving Company — Dallas labor only
listings.area: Dallas · Greenville Avenue (North Dallas, near LBJ)

hours.notes: The Dallas labor-only page lists the Greenville Ave address with hours “Mon to Sun, 7:30 AM to 7:30 PM.” The page header also shows a different phone number, (830) 542-8608; the number listed with the Dallas address is used here.

offers: Rental truck, pod, and container loading
listings.offersNotes: The official page says the crew will load or unload your rental truck, pod, or container anywhere in Dallas, with all equipment included.
listings.visitNotes: Confirm crew availability for your date. The page says a one-hour deposit holds a local date.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-19: the page says Dallas labor-only uses the same hourly rate card as its full moves — $160/hr (2 movers), $220/hr (3 movers), $310/hr (4 movers), $375/hr (5 movers) — with a two-hour minimum plus travel time.

listings.name: Dallas Packing Service — Loading/Unloading (Labor Only)

hours.notes: Hours from the official loading page: Monday–Sunday 7:00 AM–7:00 PM. The page says to text “MOVE” to the listed number for a quote.
